brief:
A government-commissioned review into antisemitism in British schools could result in a ban on teachers wearing pro-Palestine badges, Middle East Eye reported. The review uses the International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance definition of antisemitism, which critics argue conflates criticism of Israel with antisemitism.

The IHRA definition's adoption in the schools review has drawn concern from those who say it restricts legitimate political expression regarding Palestine.
dek: IHRA definition used in UK schools antisemitism review, which could see Palestine badges banned Teachers in British schools could be banned from wearing pro-Palestine badges after a government-commissioned review into antisemitism in schools.
title: UK schools antisemitism review may ban Palestine badges for teachers
